A Psalm of David. I will sing of Your loving devotion and justice; to You, O LORD, I will sing praises.
I will make a song of mercy and righteousness; to you, O Lord, will I make melody.
（大衛的詩）。我要歌唱慈愛和公平；耶和華啊，我要向你歌頌！
I will ponder the way that is blameless— when will You come to me? I will walk in my house with integrity of heart.
I will do wisely in the way of righteousness: O when will you come to me? I will be walking in my house with a true heart.
我要用智慧行完全的道。你幾時到我這裡來呢？我要存完全的心行在我家中。
I will set no worthless thing before my eyes. I hate the work of those who fall away; it shall not cling to me.
I will not put any evil thing before my eyes; I am against all turning to one side; I will not have it near me.
邪僻的事，我都不擺在我眼前；悖逆人所做的事，我甚恨惡，不容沾在我身上。
A perverse heart shall depart from me; I will know nothing of evil.
The false heart I will send away from me: I will not have an evil-doer for a friend.
彎曲的心思，我必遠離；一切的惡人（或譯：惡事），我不認識。
Whoever slanders his neighbor in secret, I will put to silence; the one with haughty eyes and a proud heart, I will not endure.
I will put to death anyone who says evil of his neighbour secretly; the man with a high look and a heart of pride is disgusting to me.
在暗中讒謗他鄰居的，我必將他滅絕；眼目高傲、心裡驕縱的，我必不容他。
My eyes favor the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me; he who walks in the way of integrity shall minister to me.
My eyes will be on those of good faith in the land, so that they may be living in my house; he who is walking in the right way will be my servant.
我眼要看國中的誠實人，叫他們與我同住；行為完全的，他要伺候我。
No one who practices deceit shall dwell in my house; no one who tells lies shall stand in my presence.
The worker of deceit will not come into my house; the false man will have no place before my eyes.
行詭詐的，必不得住在我家裡；說謊話的，必不得立在我眼前。
Every morning I will remove all the wicked of the land, that I may cut off every evildoer from the city of the LORD.
Morning by morning will I put to death all the sinners in the land, so that all evil-doers may be cut off from Jerusalem.
我每日早晨要滅絕國中所有的惡人，好把一切作孽的從耶和華的城裡剪除。
